Definition: of uncertain derivation; a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia:--of Macedonia, Macedonian.
BiblicalUsage: Makedon is a Macedonian, a man of Macedonia, and it appears where the gospel meets the province. Acts 16:9 has the man of Macedonia standing and praying, come over into Macedonia and help us, and Acts 19:29 has Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, caught with Paul in the riot at Ephesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the Macedonian's prayer in Acts 16:9 is the call that turned the gospel westward toward Europe.
